decision_points.question: are goalkeepers kept in the analysis sample?
decision_points.why_rival: each settles whether goalkeeper dyads are included in or excluded from the estimation sample

decision_points.question: how is the skin-tone rating operationalized as the model's exposure variable (continuous factor, dichotomized, trichotomized, or binned, and at which cutpoints)?
decision_points.why_rival: each is a mutually exclusive way of turning the skin-tone scale into the predictor — you use one representation as the primary exposure, not several at once

decision_points.question: which regression model/estimator is fit to the clustered binary outcome?
decision_points.why_rival: GEE logistic, a linear-probability/design-matrix regression, and a binomial mixed model are rival estimation frameworks; the analyst commits to one primary model

decision_points.question: how is effect modification by the moderator examined?
decision_points.why_rival: settles whether the moderator is handled by stratified refitting

decision_points.question: how is inter-rater agreement between the two skin-tone raters quantified?
decision_points.why_rival: Cronbach's alpha versus Pearson-plus-mean-absolute-difference are alternative reliability statistics for the same rater pair

decision_points.question: how are the two raters' codes reduced to a single skin-tone variable?
decision_points.why_rival: settles the rule for collapsing the two rater columns into one exposure value

decision_points.question: how is the linear probability model's validity checked (out-of-[0,1] predicted probabilities)?
decision_points.why_rival: both are the same out-of-range predicted-probability diagnostic for the LPM, phrased two ways

decision_points.question: is an equidispersion diagnostic run on the red-card counts?
decision_points.why_rival: settles whether variance-vs-mean is checked as a count-model adequacy diagnostic

decision_points.question: which effect measures are derived and reported?
decision_points.why_rival: settles whether risk difference, relative risk, and odds ratio are all produced together

decision_points.question: in what units is the risk difference reported?
decision_points.why_rival: settles whether the RD is rescaled from a proportion to percentage points

decision_points.question: how is the standard error obtained?
decision_points.why_rival: settles whether the SE is backed out from the bootstrap CI width under a normality assumption

decision_points.question: how is the verdict on hypothesis support decided and framed?
decision_points.why_rival: an elaborated bundle of significance rules with a suggestive fallback versus a bare SUPPORTED declaration are rival ways of translating results into a conclusion

decision_points.question: how are stepwise variable-selection thresholds (and CI width) set?
decision_points.why_rival: settles the entry/removal criteria for the stepwise model-building procedure

decision_points.question: how are laterally-symmetric position variants coded?
decision_points.why_rival: settles whether left/right position variants are merged into a side-agnostic category

decision_points.question: how are unmapped player positions handled?
decision_points.why_rival: settles the fallback for positions with no mapping (default to goalkeeper vs. a residual bucket)

decision_points.question: how are the bootstrap optimizer's iterations and convergence warnings configured?
decision_points.why_rival: settles the iteration cap and warning-suppression setting for the bootstrap refits

decision_points.question: which numerical optimizer is used for model convergence?
decision_points.why_rival: settles whether a non-default optimizer is selected to achieve convergence
